description: This file provides functions for handling file system stat data, including munging sizes, filling stat structures, setting times, matching stat data, and validating stat information. It is part of a project dealing with file metadata and version control tracking.

methods.name: unsigned int munge_st_size(off_t st_size)
methods.description: Converts signed file size to an unsigned representation, adjusting for files exactly multiple of 4 GiB to avoid being marked as racily clean.

methods.name: void fill_stat_data(struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Fills a custom stat_data structure with information from a system's stat struct.

methods.name: void set_times(struct stat * st,const struct stat_data * sd)
methods.description: Sets the ctime and mtime fields of a struct stat from a stat_data structure, handling different system definitions.

methods.name: void fake_lstat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Populates a struct stat with data from a stat_data structure, proxying a stat result.

methods.name: int match_stat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Compares stored stat_data with a system's stat struct to determine if they differ.

methods.name: void stat_validity_clear(struct stat_validity * sv)
methods.description: Clears or frees the stored stat_data in a stat_validity structure.

methods.name: int stat_validity_check(struct stat_validity * sv,const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the stored stat_data matches the current file state at a given path.

methods.name: void stat_validity_update(struct stat_validity * sv,int fd)
methods.description: Updates the stored stat_data with the latest file info from an open file descriptor.

ctags.name: set_times
ctags.pattern: /^static void set_times(struct stat *st, const struct stat_data *sd)$/
